_readme: Registry of cron-route schedulers that live OUTSIDE this repo, plus
(runs in `npm run build` and CI). vercel.json crons are read directly and
are NOT duplicated here. pgCron entries mirror the live pg_cron jobs on
2026-08-07. If you add/remove a pg_cron job via migration, update this
file in the same PR — the guard fails the build on drift it can detect
(a manifest path with no route on disk, or a route with no registration).

unscheduled.reason: Dormant real-send dispatch path; manual-trigger only; short-circuits unless CADENCE_REAL_SEND_ENABLED (per its docblock).

Shadow cadence engine (CRM Migration Phase 2 rail 1); records what it WOULD send into outbound_messages with shadow=true and dispatches nothing. Its backing migration (supabase/migrations/20260703_cadence_engine_shadow.sql) IS applied to prod, so the engine is live-but-unscheduled, not inert: no scheduler means no shadow ledger accumulates on its own. Deliberately unscheduled per its docblock until the ledger has been eyeballed on a manual run, ahead of any rail cutover.

J8 quiet-file nudge. Deliberately deferred, NOT an oversight: the schedule exists as a held-back draft at supabase/migrations-draft/20260702_quiet_file_nudge_cron_schedule.sql, and commit 11bc04f3 ('apply milestone-assistant schema to prod, defer cron scheduling') applied the schema half only. The gate is operator verification before it starts emailing lawyers daily. Verify with the read-only SQL in the route docblock, NOT by invoking the route: the route inserts notification_outbox rows, which notification-batch-5m drains into real Resend email within 5 minutes. Moot as of 2026-08-07 in any case: client_matters is empty (0 rows), so it would scan nothing. Revisit when the portal carries its first active matter.

Pre-production acknowledgement-SLA escalation. Deliberately unscheduled and inert unless VOICE_RECOVERY_SLA_ESCALATION_ENABLED=true; schedule only after the recovery queue has passed scenario testing and Adriano explicitly approves production activation.
